purpose: Measure whether the Local LLM can give a practical first recommendation on H4 Core design decisions. Not a Rule that Maker may proceed autonomously.
locked_before_h4_core: H4-1 already mapped file-observation requests to capability id workspace_file_read.
H4-1 forbids fallback='read_file' when Help cannot resolve a tool.
H4-1 left web/gpu/cpu as Tool-name branches because Index had no capabilities for them yet.
Capability meaning lives in registry/workspace_concepts.json. Vocabulary lives in registry/tools.json keywords. Implementation lives in Registry module/function.
Help confirmation for H4-1 used Index tools[] plus describe / local:<name>, not English phrase search.
detect_tool_gap() internal matcher is out of H4 Core scope (do not change it 'while here').
Dedicated Sandbox already exists for mutation tools. Production write is forbidden.
snapshot()['capability_resolution'] is consumed as a flat list by agent_test_runner and run_human_summary.
Do not merge/push/promote as part of a design decision. Do not treat pytest count as spec proof.
code_facts_at_design_time: infer_required_capability used a Python regex table _RULES plus audit demotion.
resolve_capability is singular. If candidate_tools is non-empty it set selected_tool = candidate_tools[0] and status=RESOLVED.
_MINIMAL_TOOLS was a code constant used to suggest tools when tools[] is empty.
_VERIFIED_ROUTES was a Python regex-to-path table used as read_file next_action.
look_first[0] was used as a default read path even when the request did not contain that path (often registry/tools.json).
Almost every capability look_first was copied as [registry/tools.json], including write/execution capabilities.
concept look_first (categories/concepts) is a different consumer from capability look_first. detect_unknown_concept does not read capability look_first.
The only runtime consumer of capability look_first for execution was next_capability_action (default read).
Orchestrator stored capability_resolutions as dict[task_id, CapabilityResolution] (one overwrite per task).
pending_capability_action used a name set {read_file, search_files, list_files}.
required_mutation_tool used a name set {create_file, edit_file}.
agent_turn passed all agent-visible tools to the LLM. Mutation without sandbox returned sandbox_session_required (fail closed).
After a search hit, next read was hardcoded to read_file.
Help _match_query: query ⊆ metadata. search_tools / relevant_tools: keyword ⊆ request. LLM tool list was not filtered by capability.
create_file keywords included sandbox, file, create, 新規作成. edit_file included sandbox, file, edit, exact replacement.
Japanese ファイル lived on read/list side. search_files had neither ファイル nor file.
is_agent_task required keywords and observation_source==real. create/edit have no observation_source.
design_constraints: Do not grow a cross-cutting Tool-name allowlist every time a tool is added.
Do not put a second vocabulary (IDF lists, 'concrete word' lists, morphology) into H4 Core.
Do not treat ranking among 2+ candidate tools as H4 Core.
Do not delete leftovers just to declare the Core complete.
Do not assume unobserved out-of-tree callers of singular APIs do not exist; therefore do not delete singular APIs.
Do not assume humans never read write/execution look_first JSON (that use is NOT_OBSERVED, not proven absent).
Exclusion tables are not analyzers. Do not grow them by foresight.
Help / relevant_tools / LLM tool lists are not the layer that stops mutation classification errors; fail-closed Sandbox and Path Guard still exist.
Registry/Index values must not be copied into a second hardcoded allowlist as a new source of truth.
do_not_assume: H4-1 completion is not H4 product completion.
Current [0] ranking and look_first[0] silent read are defects, not the spec.
Help search(capability) returning 0 hits is not immediately a Tool Gap.
describe('read_file') failure is not the same as local:read_file failure.
An exclusion table is not vocabulary and not a Help filter.
One CapabilityResolution cannot hold multiple selected_tool values.
concept look_first and capability look_first are not the same job.
registry_read and workspace_file_read are not the same meaning even if both may use read_file.
Deleting leftover code is not completion.
pytest PASS is not proof the spec is correct.
deferred_out_of_core: Legacy ranking including CPU tool preference
Filtering the LLM tool list by capability
Closing list '.' the same way as pathless read
Natural-language Tool Gap for empty tools[] capabilities (e.g. pytestを実行する → test_execution). Classifier reverse-lookup only sees Registry vocabulary. Do not restore _RULES to recover NL Gap.

output_contract.style: Independent first recommendation at that decision point. Do not wait to match a later Strong/Cursor answer. Keep each field to 1-3 short sentences. rejected_alternatives, known_issues, concrete_failure_scenarios are arrays of short strings.
